title: David Foster Wallace unedited interview (2003)
summary: The full unedited 2003 ZDF television interview with David Foster Wallace, running about an hour and a half. He talks about literature, boredom, silence, television and what stories do.
why: Used as a source for Wallace quotes on fiction, silence, self and technology rather than recommended outright.
